title: Three-Lane Highway Simultaneous Lane Change Into Center Lane: Left-Lane Car Yields to Right-Lane Car

teaching_correct.note: Shows symmetric simultaneous move with equal position; does not demonstrate left-lane car yielding back to right-lane car, so learner could infer both may enter together.
